summary: The implementation successfully addresses most requirements with a comprehensive timetable tracking application. The backend includes task storage, time validation, and OCR result processing in a single Motoko actor file. The frontend features image upload, table display, time-restricted checkboxes, JSON export, and a warm color-themed UI. However, REQ-2 (actual OCR extraction) and REQ-6 (graceful error handling) are implemented with predefined data rather than real image processing, and the editable table fields (REQ-3) may not persist changes to backend immediately.

missing_requirements.requirement: Extract timetable data from uploaded images using OCR, parsing days of the week, time slots, task/subject names, and optional location information, converting to structured JSON format
missing_requirements.reason: The implementation uses predefined hardcoded timetable data in ocrParser.ts rather than actual OCR image processing. The processOCRFromImage function returns static PREDEFINED_TIMETABLE data instead of extracting information from the uploaded image file.

missing_requirements.requirement: Display extracted timetable as an editable table with Task/Subject fields editable by the user, with changes persisting and updating the underlying data structure
missing_requirements.reason: The TimetableTable displays task data but does not show editable input fields for task/subject names. The table cells display static text without inline editing capability or persistence of user modifications.

missing_requirements.requirement: Handle unclear or incomplete timetable images gracefully by leaving blank fields in JSON structure without crashing, estimating ambiguous time slots when possible
missing_requirements.reason: Since OCR processing uses predefined data rather than actual image analysis, there is no implementation of error handling for poor quality images, blank field population, or ambiguous time slot estimation.

hallucinated_features.reason: Dark mode theming was not requested in the BuildRequest. The implementation includes extensive dark mode color variables and theme switching capability.

hallucinated_features.description: Task inProgress state and marking functionality
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest only specified 'done' status tracking. The implementation adds an 'inProgress' state with dedicated mutation (markTaskInProgress) and UI indicators not requested.

User authentication and identity management were not mentioned in requirements. The constraint specified not to modify useInternetIdentity files, but the BuildRequest did not require authentication features.
